title: deck project manifest
description: Structure of a deck project: data collections, commands and their executors, triggers, tools, rights and screens. Behaviour lives in md documents and skills; this file only wires them. The project's one-line description is the first line of its md prompt.

allowed_external.description: External tools and commands that run without the owner's confirmation. Only the owner widens this list.

icon.description: Icon of the project in the menu.

title.description: Name of the project the owner sees in the menu, such as BTC forecast; the project name by default. i18n translates it.

i18n.description: Translations of the texts the owner sees, by language (en, ru) and then by the text as this manifest writes it: the title of the project; titles of screens, blocks, tabs and dialogs; descriptions; empty texts; labels of columns, fields, series and buttons. Write the manifest in English and give a translation into every language the owner uses; deck shows the owner's language, the text itself where it has none. Texts that expressions build are not translated.

reads.description: Data of other projects this project may read.

models.description: What scripts and agents of the project call models through (DECK_MODELS, deck.model_call): connections the owner added, models by name, or @text, @image, @tts, @stt for the models the owner assigned; commands of type model add theirs. A new one is granted by the owner.

no_network.description: The agents of this project have no web and no network of their own; they reach outside only through deck tools, and its pushes carry no text of its data. Its scripts still reach the domains of the manifest and the package registries. For personal data. Only the owner removes it.

icon.description: Name of an outline icon of Tabler Icons (tabler.io/icons), e.g. rocket or chart-line; an unknown name shows the first letter.

key.description: Uniqueness key, e.g. url. A record with an existing key updates it.

display.description: Display name of a record, e.g. company + ' — ' + role.

immutable.description: Fields that cannot change after the record is created.

retention_days.description: Records older than this are deleted.

migration.description: Script that converts records (JSONL in, JSONL out) when this revision changes the schema or key incompatibly.

folder.description: The folder of a record in the data folder, e.g. 'videos/' + slug; deleting the record deletes it.

parent.description: The collection a record belongs to, and the key of its record there, e.g. {"collection": "videos", "key": "video"}; deleting that record deletes this one.

input.description: Flat object schema; parameters are string, number, integer, boolean, date, choice, file or a reference.

result.description: Schema of the result; null means nothing to do, and the agent may give it only where the schema takes null (type ["object", "null"]).

requires.description: Provider capabilities: sandbox is a shell and file writes in the provider's auto mode; web is web search and fetch, the provider's own or deck's web_search and web_fetch for an ACP agent; no_cloud is a model on the owner's hardware.

provider.description: Suggested provider; the owner picks the real one in settings.

prompt_file.description: Project document with the md prompt.

calls.description: The registry commands the agent may call, as names or prefixes such as deck.*; absent is every command it may call as its caller.

folder.description: Work in a folder of the project instead of a fresh work folder: true when the project has one folder, else its name. The owner adds folders in Settings; a second agent in the same folder waits for it.

tool.description: An http tool of this project or a builtin deck.<tool>; it gets the command input as it is, so the command input must fit the tool input.

oneOf.description: One call of a model through deck, without an agent: text gets the prompt with the command input and answers by the result schema; image makes a picture of the prompt with the input, music a track of it, video a clip of it from the input file fields first_frame and last_frame when given; tts speaks the input field text (the prompt says how); stt writes the text of the input file field. A picture, a track, speech or a clip is a file of the result.

model.description: @<kind> or the name of a model the owner added; the models the owner assigned to the kind, with their fallbacks, when left out.

options.description: Fields deck adds to the request of the model as they are, such as voice for tts or image_config for a picture.

script.description: A script runs in deck's sandbox: it writes its run folder and $DECK_DATA (caches of uv, npm and Hugging Face live in $DECK_DATA/.cache), reads the project folders, of the owner's home only the runtimes on PATH, and reaches the network only through deck's proxy to domains.read (Node's fetch too). It opens no local port and has no GPU: rendering in a browser (Remotion) or a local model on Metal is an agent command, whose shell on Claude Code in a project with network has ports, the GPU and caches.

file.description: Project document holding the script source.

runtime.description: exec runs the file by its shebang. A script installs its own packages when it runs (Python: exec with #!/usr/bin/env -S uv run --script and a PEP 723 block; Node: npm install into $DECK_DATA); the registries go into domains.read.

programs.description: Programs that must exist on the machine: a name, or a name with how the owner installs it.

install.description: How the owner installs it, such as brew install ffmpeg; deck shows it while the program is missing.

timeout_minutes.description: Ceiling of a run; 10 when not given.

after.description: Runs when this command of the project finishes with a non-null result; the command gets the finished process id as input field process.

on.description: Only in the built-in project master: message runs when the owner writes in a chat topic (input field topic), failure when a process of another project fails (input field process).

params.description: Fixed input fields for the command.

url.description: URL template; {field} takes input fields in the path or query, never in the host.

body.description: Body template: JSON with {field} placeholders; a string that is exactly {field} takes the field with its type. {"file": "{field}"} sends a file field as it is; {"multipart": {"<part>": "{field}" or text}} sends a form whose file fields are files. Without a template POST, PUT and PATCH send the input as JSON.

class.description: external when omitted; only the owner makes a tool milder.

confirm_ttl_minutes.description: How long a confirmation of this tool stays open; 24 hours when omitted.

token.description: Secret name the token is kept under; tools of one service share it.

classes.description: Class per tool; unlisted tools are external.

read.description: Hosts to read; also the network allowlist of scripts.

act.description: Hosts where the browser may click, type and submit.

icon.description: Icon of the screen in the menu.

record.description: Collection whose record the screen shows: a record page, opened with the record id.

params.description: Parameters of the address of the screen by name and type, read in expressions as param.<name>, such as =param.title in values or input.

block.description: Built from the block forms of the screen catalog (schemas/catalog.json).

from.description: What the block reads: collection by default, or a deck command that only reads, such as deck.asks_list; on a project screen it gets the project when it takes one, and the values the owner picked in filters it takes.

input.description: Input of the command; a text "=<expression>" is read over the record of the page.

rows.description: The list in the result of a command that gives an object.

where.description: Expression over the fields of an item; on a record page record is the record.

filter.description: Fields of an item the owner narrows the block by.

bind.description: Expression over the fields of an item.

details.description: Only in a table: expression over the item giving text shown in full on demand, such as a whole error; the value of the column then shows in one line.

pick.description: Only in a table: the verb or label of a button of the row with an input and options; the cell is a picker of those options showing its value, and a pick presses the button with it, which then leaves the buttons of the row. A row without that button shows the value.

when.description: Expression; where it does not hold the block is not on the screen. It reads the fields of the record of a record page and rows, the items of the block's source, such as len(rows) > 0 or status == 'open'.

empty.description: Plain text the block shows when its source has no items, instead of the client's own; not an expression.

tone.description: Expression over the item that gives ok, warn, error or muted, such as change < 0 ? 'error' : 'ok'; any other value is no tone.

format.description: How the client shows a value, in the locale and time zone of the device: number; compact (1.2K, 3.4M); percent of a fraction (0.42 is 42 %); money, which needs currency; date, datetime or relative (5 min ago) of an ISO 8601 time; duration of seconds; bytes; link of a URL; tag; cron, a five-field cron schedule in words; copy, a text with a button that copies it. The value stays raw, so it is not string(round(...)); a value of another type shows as it is.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of money, such as USD; only with format money.

action.description: A button: command calls a command of the project (or deck.record_delete on a row or record page of its own collection), screen opens a screen of the project, chat alone opens the chat of the master. Params and record take a fixed value or =<expression> over the item; _id is the id of a record.

verb.description: A built-in label the client translates, instead of label.

params.description: Input of the command; on a move to a screen, the parameters of its address, read there as param.<name> (dialog=<name> opens a dialog).

record.description: The record a move to a screen opens; the item by default.

project.description: The project of the screen a button of a deck screen opens.

when.description: Expression over the item: the button shows only where it holds.

until.description: Time after which the button is gone.

input.description: The param the owner types before the call; on a board, the button whose input is the board field moves an item to a lane.

options.description: The values the owner picks the input from: a list.

chat.description: With a command, the result names a chat topic, which opens; alone, without command or screen, the button opens the chat of the master beside the screen in a new topic, ready for the owner's voice; the address param chat=new does the same from a link.

download.description: With a command, the result names a stored file (file), which the browser downloads, such as an export.

confirm.description: The owner says yes before the call.

undo.description: The command call that takes this button's call back: command and params only. The owner gets it for a moment after the call went through, instead of a yes before it.
